title: Spiriti! Napoli '97
subtitle: Unofficial Ghostbusters-inspired tribute game set in Naples, 1997
technology: PRG32 portable ABI-table cartridge for the default 64 KiB cartridge-RAM profile
4-bpp palette-indexed tiles and sprites, one colour per system-cube cell for exact colours on the ESP32-C6
palette effects: fades, capture flash, glowing spirits, cycling proton beam, sky stained by PK energy, lightning
row parallax along the lungomare with a sky gradient on reserved palette entries
ten SID-like procedural instruments, eight tracker tracks, stereo-panned effects on four voices
acknowledgements: A tribute to the paranormal-comedy arcade tradition popularized by Ghostbusters and 1980s home-computer games
Original soundtrack; no film, television or game theme is quoted
content_notice: TRIBUTE GAME - unofficial and unaffiliated. Ghostbusters is referenced only to identify the work being paid tribute to. The game uses original branding, artwork, music, effects and code designed to evoke the era without reproducing protected franchise assets.

controls.action: Map: choose a district. Drive: brake / accelerate. Capture: move the trap
Map: choose a district. Drive: change lane
Start, dispatch the Fiat, fire the proton beam
Back to the title, return to base, give the job up

start_prompt: Press A to start the night shift
tribute_statement: Spiriti! Napoli '97 is an unofficial, non-commercial tribute game celebrating the paranormal-comedy arcade tradition associated with Ghostbusters and the 1984 era. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the Ghostbusters rights holders. All cartridge code, pixel artwork, title treatment, melodies and sound effects in this project are original; no Ghostbusters logo, character art, dialogue, soundtrack melody, recording, or game asset is included.
